title: Maximum in an Array
description:
Given an integer n followed by n integers, print the largest value in the array.

Input format:
The first line contains n. The second line contains n space-separated integers.

Output format:
Print the largest integer.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The largest value in the array is 9.
All values are negative, and -3 is the largest.

title: Valid Parentheses
description:
Given a string containing only the characters '(', ')', '[', ']', '{', and '}', determine whether every opening bracket is closed by the same type of bracket in the correct order. Print true if the string is valid; otherwise print false.

Input format:
A single non-empty string of brackets.

Output format:
Print true or false.

visibleTestCases.explanation: Each opening bracket is closed by its matching bracket in the correct order.
The closing parenthesis appears before the matching square bracket is closed.
